claims.text: Zinc oxide paste (Desitin) Drug Facts: helps treat and prevent diaper rash; protects chafed skin and helps seal out wetness;
claims.quote: helps treat and prevent diaper rash • protects chafed skin due to diaper rash and helps seal out wetness

claims.text: change wet and soiled diapers promptly, cleanse and dry the area, then apply liberally w each diaper change, esp at bedtime.
